task_title: Refresh agent personas, promote them to invocable agents, and converge the asset pipeline

plan_review.notes: Three alternatives were enumerated and argued (agent-first single source with generated persona docs; persona-first single source with generated agent frontmatter; keep two selectable asset agents deduped via a shared template). The two-layer model was retained, but five changes landed: the guard now actually enforces canonical-agent cardinality and agent->persona backlinks (the README claim was previously unenforced), check-paths tracks fenced-block state, producer.ts no longer silently defaults unmapped systems to Game Designer, asset-forge requires explicit human confirmation before issue-wave mode, and the README records who owns load-time LLM content if it is ever built (the gap left by retiring AI Content Engineer).
